notes.title: The demo now supports 9 more language!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you're having a wonderful day.

Harvest Bliss demo now supports 9 more languages:

- Spanish
- French
- German
- Italian
- Portuguese
- Japanese
- Korean
- Simplified Chinese
- Russian

If you haven't tried the demo yet because of the localization, now is the perfect time to try it:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2921620/Harvest_Bliss/

Please let me know your thoughts and if there are any other languages you'd like to see in the future.

Happy gaming!
- Pandazole

notes.title: Harvest Bliss Demo Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you are having a lovely day.

Harvest Bliss Demo is [b]LIVE NOW[/b], It took a little longer than expected, but there we are :D

If you would like to try it out, please head up to the Steam Page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2921620/Harvest_Bliss/

Please let me know your thoughts!

Happy Gaming!
- Pandazole

notes.title: Demo release date!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I hope you're having a great day!

I'm planning to release a demo at [strike] the end of this month, so within 7-11 days.[/strike]

It's more of a public beta than a demo, allowing me to gather early feedback from the community and refine the game even further.

Your insights will be invaluable in identifying any issues and improving the overall experience.

Please stay tuned for more details, and thank you in advance for your support and participation!


[b] EDIT: The demo will be delayed a little bit; it needs more cleaning 😆. Hopefully, it'll be ready in the early days of July.[/b]

Happy gaming!
- Pandazole
